name: Data.exists_isSphericalWith_iota
summary: Induction along the chain Y₀ → Y_m: the eigenpart is spherical at split places off the level, and each lift transfers sphericity (Hecke transfer for theta lifts).

steps.claim: ι(1) is the algebraic form of the lift chain liftChainY(1, ·); being spherical with a given Hecke polynomial is the same for a form and its algebraic form (`isSphericalWith_toAlgForm_iff`), so it suffices to find F for the chain liftChainY(1, m)(y) of y.
Write m as the value of the last element of {0, …, m} (`Fin.val_last`), so that the claim can be proved for every length of the chain by induction.

Induction on the length i of the chain (`Fin.induction`). For length 0 the chain is the identity, and a form y in the p-eigenpart is spherical at every split w off the level with Hecke polynomial heckePolyEval(RowIndex(D), w, p(w, ·)) (`Data.isSphericalWith_of_mem_eigenPart`): take F(w) to be this polynomial function.
steps.lean:
induction' last _ using
    induction with i ih; exact ⟨_, fun _ h _ ↦ D.isSphericalWith_of_mem_eigenPart _ h⟩

steps.claim: Inductive step: the chain of length i + 1 is a scalar multiple of the theta lift, by the datum datumY(1, i), of the chain of length i, and this datum is an arrow (`Data.isArrow_datumY`). By the induction hypothesis ih the chain of length i is spherical at w with Hecke polynomial F_i(w); the Hecke transfer for theta lifts (`isSphericalWith_formLift`) makes its lift spherical at w with the transferred polynomial X ↦ trivialHecke(q_w, k, a(w)X)·F_i(w)(q_w^k a(w)X/b(w)), provided the datum is unramified at w (its projection to the places off the level is itself, `Space.projOn_integrated`, `Space.projOn_name_vacElem`) and the two characters are unramified at w (left open); a scalar multiple keeps this property.
steps.lean:
refine ⟨_, fun y a w h ↦
    (isSphericalWith_formLift card_sum ?_ ?_ h.1 ((projOn_integrated ..).trans (congrArg _
    (projOn_name_vacElem _ ?_))) (D.isArrow_datumY _ i.2).1 (ih.choose_spec y a w h)).smul⟩

steps.claim: The characters of the lift are unramified at w: a character of given weight is unramified at every place where its tame part is 1 (`AutChar.HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt`), and the tame part of the character of the auxiliary pair is 1 off its places (`AuxPair.tame_eq_one`).

The remaining conditions, that w and w̄ are not among the places of the level and of the auxiliary pairs, hold because w is split and off the chosen places above g (IsSplitOffLevel(D, w)) and the trivial twist has empty modulus Q (`places_levelModulus`, `Data.levelPlaces`).
steps.lean: all_goals simp_all [places_levelModulus, IsSplitOffLevel, auxPair, levelPlaces]; tauto
